test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: All 24 students of a class are standing in a straight row facing north. Amit is 3rd from the right end, while Maria is 3rd from the left end. How many students stand between Maria and Amit?
solution:
Given: 24 students.

Amit is 3rd from the right end, 

Maria is 3rd from the left end. 

So, students between Maria and Amit = 24 - 3 - 3 = 18. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/485697337a7e634bd837fbb3e7a7a00d9b2131d17d8698f63ff79de5d259548c.png] 

So, there are '**18**' students stand between Maria and Amit.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
